definitions.explanation: More than what is necessary, normal, or desirable.

examples.japanese: {過剰|かじょう}な⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's better not to have excessive expectations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧{過剰|かじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We lowered prices due to excess inventory.

examples.japanese: {過剰|かじょう}な⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦もと→元：03878_moto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Excessive confidence is the source of failure.

notes:
USAGE: {過剰|かじょう} indicates an undesirable amount of something.

COMPOUNDS:
- {過剰|かじょう}⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ (overproduction)
- {過剰|かじょう}⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧ (excessive intake)
- {過剰|かじょう}⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧ (overreaction)
- {過剰|かじょう}⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧ (excessive packaging)
- ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧{過剰|かじょう} (overpopulation)
- ⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧{過剰|かじょう} (oversupply)

GRAMMAR: Used as na-adjective ({過剰|かじょう}な〜) or as noun suffix.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧ - shortage, deficiency (opposite)
- ⟦{適度|てきど}→適度：03441_tekido⟧ - moderate (appropriate amount)
